### Summary

This PR points the advisory review workflow at the renamed engine repository, `niway-dev/wachiman`, pins it to `v1.2.1`, and updates the CI/CD doc to match. Both edits are consistent with each other and keep the exact-tag pinning. The one gap: ADR 0028 still names `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer` and `v1.2.0`, and the PR adds no amendment for this rename.

> ℹ️ No critical issues — one stale doc reference outside the diff. **Reviewed changes** Reviewed the move of the reusable review workflow from `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer@v1.2.0` to `niway-dev/wachiman@v1.2.1`. - **Workflow pin** — `agent-review.yml` now calls `niway-dev/wachiman/.github/workflows/review.yml@v1.2.1`. I confirmed that `refs/tags/v1.2.1` exists in the public `niway-dev/wachiman` (commit `82942b74`), and that `review.yml` is byte-identical at `v1.2.0` and `v1.2.1`. The `operator`/`model` inputs, the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` secret, the job permissions and the `/wachi` mention default are all unchanged, so the caller needs no other edit. - **Docs** — the comment in `agent-review.yml` and `deployment/ci-cd-pipelines.md` now name `niway-dev/wachiman`. ### ℹ️ ADR 0028 still names `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer` and `v1.2.0` as current The previous rename (`agent-review` → `wachi-reviewer`) updated ADR 0028's Status row and added a dated amendment. This rename does neither. After merge, the ADR's Status row still says the review is "now consumed through the reusable workflow `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer`", and its newest amendment says the engine is pinned to `v1.2.0`. Both are wrong once this lands, and `ci-cd-pipelines.md` (which this PR does update) now disagrees with the ADR.
Technical details ````markdown # ADR 0028 is stale after the wachiman rename ## Affected sites - apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0028-advisory-claude-review-on-pull-requests.mdx:12 — Status row says "now consumed through the reusable workflow `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer`" and links the v1.2.0 amendment as the latest. - apps/documentation/src/content/docs/architecture/decisions/0028-advisory-claude-review-on-pull-requests.mdx:93-101 — the latest amendment pins `v1.2.0` in `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer`. ## Required outcome - The Status row names `niway-dev/wachiman` as the current engine. - A dated amendment (2026-10-31) records the rename (wachiman ADR 0009), says that `uses:` is not redirected, and records the bump to `v1.2.1`. Keep the earlier amendments as history. ````

> ℹ️ No new issues in the version bump. The earlier ADR 0028 note is still open. **Reviewed changes** Reviewed the one change since the prior review: the engine pin moved from `v1.2.1` to `v1.3.0`. - **Pin bump**: `agent-review.yml` now calls `niway-dev/wachiman/.github/workflows/review.yml@v1.3.0`. I confirmed that `refs/tags/v1.3.0` exists in `niway-dev/wachiman` (commit `c95bc5ee`). `review.yml` is byte-identical at `v1.2.1` and `v1.3.0`, so the inputs, the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` secret, the job permissions and the default cost caps cited in the caller's comments are all unchanged. The engine matches comments with `contains(github.event.comment.body, inputs.mention)` and the default is still `/wachi`, so `/wachiman` already triggers it and the caller's `/wachi review` text stays valid. The earlier body note still applies: ADR 0028's Status row names `niway-dev/wachi-reviewer`, and its newest amendment pins `v1.2.0`. Now that the bump goes to `v1.3.0`, the amendment that records the rename should name `v1.3.0` too.   ｜ [Fix it ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/474?action=fix&review_id=5724402795) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41231611737/job/124626821597) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
